added_failures_note: Derived with reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs over the reviewed run's own logs/wide-arm-base.log (revision cb557f9711670ca8a00dd1d6dd22a17b42d3a51e, read from the scratch tree the arm records) and logs/wide-arm-head3.log (revision 6c9ebbbd15eac8ad2b7f717f60e789f99b1823db): the base log reports 75 failed plus 8 errors, the head log 62 failed, both ran to their summary line, and the head failing set is a subset of the base set, so the added-failure set is empty.

assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Deleting the six-line write at preparation.py:708-713 leaves dispatch_field returning None, so the subscript raises TypeError; logs/negative-control.log:4067 shows that traceback.

A launch that re-picks instead of replaying stores no picker_selection on the admitted request, reddening the same read; the control log reports test_metered_wait_keeps_its_pick_and_launches_after_upstream_lands FAILED at :5621.

A queued request whose pick is dropped launches the default lane, so the stored selection's model is absent; the control log reports test_queued_pick_launches_the_selected_nondefault_model FAILED at :5622.
A moved request losing its original pick reads None and reddens; the control log reports test_a_move_launches_on_its_explicit_destination FAILED at :5623.

The fixture's picked_at is read from the clock rather than written down, so a launch replays only while the pick is inside the re-pick bound at reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:1584-1592; dropping it makes the launch re-pick and the fourth case's fallback list empty, which the control log reports at :5624.
The two sides are copies of one dispatch_options entry, so only a copy step that drops route_fallback reddens it; it does not guard the fallback rule.

findings.text: The red-file record quotes the two gate summary lines as '4 failed, 8 passed in 3.54s' (line 13) and '12 passed in 5.07s' (line 20), but the logs it names read '4 failed, 8 passed in 4.75s' (logs/base-arm.log:161) and '12 passed in 6.32s' (logs/head-arm.log:7); line 19 records the head revision as 'cb557f9711 plus this node's change' where logs/head-arm.log:1 names 6c9ebbbd15. The counts reconcile and the ids are right, the quoted lines are in neither log.

The done_when asks for the file to pass 'at head as a job on all_debug with SLURM_JOB_ID unset'; every arm the manifest and its logs record is an in-place local pytest run under `env -u SLURM_JOB_ID` (manifest.md:9, logs/base-arm.log:3, logs/head-arm.log:3) and no sbatch or srun invocation appears in the run's transcript. The variable-unset condition and the measure are met; the named environment is not, so the clause cannot be read as satisfied from the record.

`runs.dispatch_field(run, 'admit_request')['route_fallback'] == run['route_fallback']` compares two copies of one value: reckon/crew/dispatching/requests.py:82-84 writes route_fallback to the record and to dispatch_options from the same entry, and reckon/crew/dispatching/launch.py:610 writes the pointer's route_fallback from that same dict. The two sides move together, so the assertion holds whatever the replay or fallback rule does once the copy is made; the node's durability does not rest on it, since logs/negative-control.log reddens the file's four other ids.
